reason: Guest describes systematic rules and hybrid algos for swing/earnings breakouts but provides no concrete, codable parameters or exact exit conditions (e.g., 'when a b and c happens I cut half'); heavy emphasis on discretionary environment/theme assessment and unicorns that cannot be backtested.

universe.description: US growth stocks, leaders in strong sectors, earnings reporters

setup.rule: double beat and raise full year guide Up breakout 52 week highs in a growth stock
setup.quote: you have your classic double beat and raise full year guide Up breakout 52 week highs in a growth stock right

setup.rule: find the leaders... strongest stocks in the market and the strongest sectors
setup.quote: I would just find the leaders I would try to identify the strongest stocks in the market and the strongest sectors in the market and then either look for pullbacks to buy them or look for breakouts

entry.rule: stock going higher on at least 5x average daily volume, preferably earlier in the day
entry.quote: it's got to be doing a lot of volume at least five times its average daily volume and it's got to be trading higher and then we just have a Time component to it so we have like certain areas that we want to be executing you know preferably earlier in the day

stop.rule: rules-based exits when a b and c happens cut half, when D happens cut full
stop.quote: when a b and c happens I cut half and when D happens I cut the full thing no matter what I don't care on to the next

exits.rule: better rules for getting out... many fish in the sea
exits.quote: I need to have better rules for getting out right because there's many fish in the sea

sizing.rule: algo sizes big on A+ acting right, small or none otherwise; environment checks upgrade/downgrade risk
sizing.quote: the Alo will will either enter the trade and it'll enter the trade big size or it'll enter small size or it'll not enter at all

market_filter.rule: leaders leading and breakouts working = momentum market; adjust A+ criteria to current environment/theme
market_filter.quote: if the leaders are leading and breakouts are working like to me that's a momentum Market... every earning season is different and so what we like to do is first try to get a feel for what is the theme right now

ambiguities.issue: exact definitions of a/b/c/D exit triggers and precise volume/time thresholds never stated
